label: Smart Litter Complete Pipeline
info: One complete flow for the Smart Litter Monitor. It receives litter/# MQTT messages from python/export_petkit_csv.py, writes sensor, alert, and heartbeat data to InfluxDB for Grafana, validates and deduplicates the four alert types, applies quiet hours, and sends Alexa announcements plus mobile push notifications.

name: One flow: MQTT, validation, InfluxDB, Grafana data, and Alexa
info: Subscribes to litter/#. Alerts are validated, deduplicated, held during quiet hours, and routed to Alexa announcements and mobile push notifications. Sensor, alert, and heartbeat messages are also written to InfluxDB for Grafana. Configure your own Alexa account and Echo device after importing.
